title: SophisticatedStorage issue #825: [Neoforge 1.21.11] ticking entity crash
licence: GitHub issue thread: user-generated content under the GitHub Terms of Service; the repo licence (NOASSERTION) does not cover issue text
text:
[issue by Baggytrousers27]
SophisticatedCore is named in the crashlog but there isn't a repo for it so posting it here instead.

Seemed to occur after cursor moved over an item in Backpack

Description: Ticking entity
com.google.common.util.concurrent.UncheckedExecutionException: java.lang.IllegalArgumentException: Failed to hash minecraft:max_damage=>0: Value must be positive: 0

[Crashlog](https://pastebin.com/RcQVcg5K)
(Will post a Full log when Gists decide to work again)

sophisticatedbackpacks-1.21.11-3.25.34.1565
sophisticatedcore-1.21.11-1.4.7.1513
sophisticateditemactions-1.21.11-0.3.4.91
sophisticatedstorage-1.21.11-1.5.35.1511
sophisticatedstorageinmotion-1.21.11-0.10.26.189

[comment by P3pp3rF1y (owner)]
Some invalid item was moved into the backpack - that item has max damage of 0 which isn't a valid value. If you can figure out what that item is author of that mod needs to fix it because that item will cause crashes in some vanilla flows as well.

[comment by Baggytrousers27 (none)]
Cheers for the insight, that'll narrow it down a bit

[comment by Baggytrousers27 (none)]
Okee doke, finally narrowed down the offending items, only problem it's Nautilus Armour. Weirdly it only seems to cause a crash when the backpack is at least gold. Currently sifting through my mods to see if any of them fiddle with the armour.

[comment by Baggytrousers27 (none)]
Alrighty, the culprit mod in question is iamkaf's bonded. When moving nautilus armour from main inventory to backpack, the game lags and then the item deletes itself, if the game doesn't crash outright.

[comment by P3pp3rF1y (owner)]
You will want to report this to them, as far as I can see that mod is closed source so there isn't even anything for me to look at.

[comment by Baggytrousers27 (none)]
There's already [an issue listed](https://github.com/iamkaf/bonded/issues/27) for it from Feb 5th but [none of their issues](https://github.com/iamkaf/bonded/issues) seem to have had any progress since Feb 12th. Darn shame cos it's a good mod idea.
